snippet.title: Don't Splat! – Official Trailer | Co-op for 1–4 Players
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5426960/Dont_Splat/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch2026&utm_content=fragman

Four blobs. One wall. Someone's in the wrong place. Stretch, squish and shape-shift with your friends to squeeze through the gaps in Don't Splat!, a co-op game for 1–4 players, online or on one screen. You had a plan. The wall had other ideas.

• Play solo, with up to three friends online, or with up to four players on one screen.
• Stretch, squash and shape-shift to fit through the walls.
• Use four elemental powers, and bring friends back with water.
• Go head-to-head with friends in versus, from 1v1 to 4v4.
• Find a look for your blob with hats, mustaches and more.

Follow Don't Splat!
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dontsplatgame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dontsplatgame
X: https://x.com/dontsplatgame
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/dontsplatgame.bsky.social

Music: "Happy Rock" by Alex_Besss (Pixabay)
